🇮🇳🤝🇦🇷 Rotary Friendship Exchange – Warm Welcome at Rotary Club of Gran Pinto

Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown | District 3141, India
RFE Argentina 2026–27 | District 4895

As part of the Rotary Friendship Exchange, the RFE delegation from District 3141, India, had the pleasure of visiting Rotary Club of Gran Pinto, Argentina, while travelling through Argentina.

The visiting delegation received a warm and gracious welcome, with our Rotary friends arranging a delightful coffee and high-tea break during our journey. The brief stop turned into a wonderful opportunity for Rotarians to connect, interact and share the spirit of fellowship. Met with their President Willie

The warmth of our hosts and their thoughtful hospitality made this short visit truly memorable. It beautifully demonstrated that Rotary friendship does not depend on the length of a meeting—sometimes a cup of coffee and a warm welcome are enough to create lasting connections.

The visit strengthened the bonds of friendship between District 3141 and the Rotary family of Argentina, adding yet another special memory to our RFE journey.

☕❤️ A Warm Welcome • A Cup of Friendship • Memories for a Lifetime
